behavior_change: Derive a source-linked Critical Moment Map from an accepted M1 version.
Represent known, missing and conflicting time without inventing dates.
Persist immutable M2 history and canonical ExperienceAsset projections atomically.
Support safe title-only autosave, optimistic concurrency and explicit confirmation.
Invalidate dependent M2 artifacts after related M1 corrections while preserving unrelated edits.
non_goals: No M3-M5 implementation, cross-asset RAG, route generation or export workflow.
No new W7900, ROCm, vLLM or performance claim.
